summary.text: Patrick Kearney is a Democratic member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives who has represented the 4th Plymouth District since January 2019 and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Kearney, listed by Ballotpedia as Patrick Joseph Kearney, took office on January 2, 2019, and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.

For the 2025-2026 session, he was assigned to the House Committee on Intergovernmental Affairs, the House Ways and Means Committee and the Community Development and Small Businesses, Ways and Means, and Veterans and Federal Affairs joint committees.
